title: SORTENTSTABLE projection reserve cardinality
scope: Right-size graph-validation scratch reservations to the data population each index stores.
Preserve existing source-record admission limits and SORTENTSTABLE semantics.

sourceChange.before: The entity index and unresolved-owner sets reserved from sourceRecords, a combined census that also counts dictionaries, tables, blocks and raw records.
sourceChange.after: Count admitted entity entries separately; reserve the entity map and unresolved handle claims from sourceEntities, and reserve unresolved physical-owner names from the number of block containers.
sourceChange.effect: Avoids reserving slots for non-entity records in the entity index/owner-claim set and avoids using per-entity record volume to size the set of distinct physical block names. Admission thresholds, traversal, lookups, and output are unchanged.

focusedTests.coverageNote: Existing SORTENTSTABLE owner-graph control covers generated entity populations, duplicate-pair policy, ASCII/Binary emission, and readback.

validation.diffCheck: passed for dwg2dxf/dx_iface.cpp, DWG_DXF_OPEN_SOURCE_PARITY_PLAN.md, and this receipt

assessment.planImpact: Closes one over-broad reservation-sizing case in the SORTENTSTABLE graph projection scratch audit. No data, limit, or support claim changed.

testsRun: Focused existing SORTENTSTABLE adapter round-trip CTest
method.limitations: No allocator instrumentation, peak RSS, or throughput benchmark was run; the reduction is source-level capacity right-sizing and not a global memory bound.
